questions.prompt: In a cloud service relationship, which statement best describes the shared responsibility model?

choices.A: Security duties are divided between the provider and customer
choices.B: The provider owns every security task
choices.C: The customer owns every infrastructure task
choices.D: Responsibility disappears when services are managed

questions.general_explanation: Cloud security responsibilities are divided between the service provider and the customer, with the exact split depending on the service model.

choice_explanations.A: Security duties are divided between the provider and customer is the best answer here. Cloud security responsibilities are divided between the service provider and the customer, with the exact split depending on the service model.
choice_explanations.B: The provider owns every security task does not best satisfy the scenario described in this question.
choice_explanations.C: The customer owns every infrastructure task does not best satisfy the scenario described in this question.
choice_explanations.D: Responsibility disappears when services are managed does not best satisfy the scenario described in this question.
